purpose: Lets users enter or edit single-line text or numeric values. Supports autocomplete suggestions, value help, 6 data types (text, number, email, URL, phone, password), and value states for validation feedback.
whenToUse: Enter a short, single-line text or number
Enter a password, URL, phone number, or email address
Select a single item from a large dataset (more than 200 items) — combine with autocomplete/suggestions and value help
Find an object by searching for more than one attribute (ID, city, customer name)
For 20–200 items use ComboBox; for fewer than 20 items use Select
whenNotToUse: Don't use Input for dates/times — use DatePicker, DateRangeSelection, or DateTimePicker
Don't use Input for long text — use TextArea
Don't use Input for selecting multiple values — use MultiComboBox (fewer than 200 items) or MultiInput (more than 200 items)
doRules: Always pair every input field with a visible label — visible labels are mandatory for accessibility
Use placeholder text as a hint or example only — never as a label replacement (placeholder disappears on typing)
Indicate required fields with asterisk (*) via Label required property
Use appropriate value states (Negative/Critical/Positive/Information) with value state messages for validation
Use Clear icon (showClearIcon=true) to let users remove typed text
Use right text alignment for numeric input (amounts, decimal values)
Implement suggestions/autocomplete to help users enter data faster
Provide real-time validation feedback as users type, not just on form submission
dontRules: Don't replace labels with placeholder text
Don't communicate error state by red border alone — include text message
Don't set a fixed width — use form containers and 12-column layout approach instead
Don't include interactive elements in custom suggestions
Don't use the icon control for button-like interactions — use the icon property

layoutGuidance.placement: Inside Form, FilterBar, Dialog, or Toolbar. Width 100% by default — determined by parent container.
layoutGuidance.sizing: Width 100% by default. Use form layout containers rather than fixed widths. Suggestion box matches input width by default.
layoutGuidance.spacing: Vertical spacing between fields: 8px Compact, 16px Cozy. S/M viewport: Cozy mode. L viewport: Compact mode.
layoutGuidance.alignment: Label above or to the left. Text alignment: right for numeric, left/begin for text-based inputs. Center alignment only for short codes.

contentGuidance.labelLength: Short, descriptive label text (e.g. 'First Name', 'Invoice Date'). Placeholder ≤ 50 chars.
contentRules: Placeholder provides hints or examples of expected format
Required fields marked with * next to label
Value state messages explain what needs correction
Supports LTR and RTL reading directions

responsiveBehavior.XL: Full table suggestions displayed. Compact mode.
responsiveBehavior.L: Full table suggestions displayed. Compact mode.
responsiveBehavior.M: Responsive table pop-in for tabular suggestions. Cozy mode.
responsiveBehavior.S: On tap: keyboard appears, view switches to full screen with input at top and suggestions below. Cozy mode. One-finger tap to select.

accessibilityGuidance.requirement: Tab: moves focus; Shift+Tab: backward. F4/Alt+Up/Down: opens value help. Escape: closes suggestion list or reverts changes. Enter: selects item. Ctrl+Alt+F8: focuses first link in value state message.
Every input MUST have a visible label. Visible labels improve usability, accessibility, and screen reader support.
Active/focus state identical. Focus state must be visible when keyboard is available.
Value state communicated by color AND icon AND text — not color alone. Custom suggestions with additional info must be accessible via invisible message.

incompatible: For multi-value selection — use MultiComboBox or MultiInput

exceptions: SAP Web Components only: Input as search field for free-text search. SAPUI5 uses SearchField instead.
SAPUI5 only: Tabular suggestions, suggestion trigger character count, key-value text format
Typeahead/autocomplete not available on Android devices
Read-only state: non-editable with grey background
types: Basic input: free text entry, no suggestions
Input with label: descriptive label above or before
Input with suggestions: autocomplete and dropdown list
Input with value help: triggers value help dialog via icon
Input with description: additional context text after field (unit, currency)
Input as search (SAP Web Components only): free-text or filter search
